name: Ferd Ray
flavorText: Ferd is an insufferable, weird, and most importantly a stubborn mindless maniac who will do anything for the people he loves, and whatever he wants for himself of course.

name: Ena Lone
flavorText: Ena Lone is a chubby hotheaded dominant force. Incredibly popular among peers, though not so much outside of the city where she came from.

name: Hazune Niku
flavorText: Cherished celebrity across the universe, responsible for many progressive automaton movements. I'm thinking Niku, Niku, ooh-ee-ooh.

name: Juno Evergreen ✰
flavorText: Juno is a cybernetic animal suffering from a taxing ailment, formerly used by the citadel as a weapon, she has now found freedom with the help of new allies.

name: Georg ✰
flavorText: Like a gamer, racist... turt- look man idk I just type these in.

name: Icy Cruz ✰
flavorText: Fat and immature.

name: Maria Ramirez ✰
flavorText: Description pending...

name: Jinx ✰
flavorText: An unemployed free spirited coyote who really cares for their friends. Loves to bully them, never too much.

name: Toby ✰
flavorText: Toby is a domestic housecat who bagged a baddie so out of his league he'll never quite figure it out.

name: Taylor ✰
flavorText: An anxious and directionless jackalope who'd be more than content drifting through life, was it not for his friends pushing him to do more.

name: Welder ✰
flavorText: Carefree robot specialising in welding, construction and repair. If you need any help with mechanical construction and repairs contact on: [REDACTED]

name: Elysia ✰
flavorText: An ancient cheetah who mysteriously washed up the coast, or at least that's the working theory. She now attempts to fit into this wholly changed world.

name: Ally Parks
flavorText: A hyperactive girl who's never boring, ever. Get close and you'll have found a real ride or die. Represses too many personal problems.

name: Houston March
flavorText: A depressed emo bunny who grew up with machines and does incredibly stupid things sometimes. Lonely, learned to live with it.

name: Lars Mai Terma
flavorText: A punk rat obsessed over racing. Some say he's the greatest pilot in the universe, many complain about his insanely reckless driving.

name: Emma Hindue
flavorText: Leader of the people on a planet no one has ever heard about. Reckless, dangerous, and unfortunately pretty crazy.

name: Veronika Barashova
flavorText: A borzoi who's a bit lonely. Loves videogames and... war machines. Frequently builds and paints plastic models, probably inhaled way too many chemicals.

name: ROSE
flavorText: A brilliant and incredibly wealthy artist striving to reach an unknown definition of creation. A bit psychotic, honestly.

name: Jessica Hatherleigh
flavorText: A really skinny cama that has a bit too much going on in her head. Someone please get her a therapist.

name: Tina Reine ✰
flavorText: A freelancer (likely unemployed) rich girl who loves to travel the world and be naked for some reason.

name: Dennis Crona ✰
flavorText: A shady furry dealer who's well known on the Dark-Net for selling... "stronger catnip".

name: Mira Rose ✰
flavorText: A special someone who often acts before they think. Born on an ice rock in outer space, somehow grew up in a normal world.

name: Vladimir Koshinov
flavorText: A genius undead soldier. Long time veteran of the resistance who would rather be tending to his greenhouse rather than constantly fighting for freedom.
